decisions.briefing: Markets drifted slightly lower today (S&P 500 -0.5%, NASDAQ -0.3%) on a neutral, low-conviction session with no risk-on confirmation. Cash on hand ($489.29) sits just below the $500 deployment threshold, so per strategy memory we held all 7 existing positions and skipped new buys rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices edged lower today, with the S&P 500 down 0.5% and the Nasdaq off 0.3%, in a broadly neutral, low-conviction session. There was no standout catalyst driving heavier volume or volatility, so the move reads more like routine consolidation after recent gains than the start of a deeper pullback. Investors appear to be waiting for a clearer directional signal before committing fresh capital.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤小幅走弱，標普500指數下跌0.5%，那斯達克指數下跌0.3%，整體屬於中性、缺乏明確方向的交易日。市場並未出現明顯利空消息帶動成交量或波動性放大，這次回檔較像是近期漲勢後的正常盤整，而非更深修正的開端。投資人似乎仍在等待更清晰的訊號，才會再度加碼資金。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" means keeping cash on the sidelines instead of investing it immediately, so it's ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity shows up. On a neutral day with cash just under the buy threshold, holding rather than forcing a trade preserves flexibility and avoids buying into a weak setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指暫時保留在場邊、尚未投入市場的現金，等到真正出現有吸引力的機會時再部署。在市場中性、現金又剛好低於買入門檻的情況下，選擇持有而非勉強交易，能保留操作彈性，避免買在條件不佳的格局中。
